texts.name: Fahada
texts.biography: A member of House Anima, Fahada came to prominence during the early days of the Orc Rebellion. Like most Sorceresses, Fahada craves power, but she also seeks the acceptance of the ruling Wizards of the Seven Cities. Doing her best to climb the social ladder has left her to adopt a serious and studious demeanor. Only her lover, the Djinn Khalida, can make her laugh and smile and see the wonders of the world.

specialty.name: Light Elem.
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Light Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 6 levels (rounded up). Can upgrade Psychic Elementals, Magic Elementals, and Astral Elementals to Light Elementals.
